spans.text: A judicial bench and battered defendant’s podium occupy a sunlit square. Three curious citizens stop to watch. Beyond the rooftops, an enormous black fortress dominates the skyline, its battlements bristling with crimson banners.
The guard places Riley behind the podium. She edges toward an open passage. Without looking up, he slides his chair into her path. She returns to the podium.
A NOXIAN MAGISTRATE sits behind the bench, armored in black iron. He puts on very small reading glasses.
You entered Noxus under suspicious circumstances—
—and knowingly selected Lux for the top lane.
I’d like to focus on the first thing.
A spectator leans closer. Riley shifts behind the podium, avoiding their gaze.
Her team’s statement: “Please. We need someone to stand in front.”
The magistrate peers at her over the podium. She reluctantly straightens.

spans.text: A courier runs along the south bank toward a footbridge. Her pursuer follows twenty paces behind. The bridge is closed by a locked gate. She sees a low service boat drifting under it, jumps down onto its roof, and disappears beneath the bridge. The pursuer reaches the locked gate and sees her emerge on the north bank.

spans.text: Two astronomers wait beside a covered telescope. The younger keeps reaching for the cover; the older steadies her hand.
When you look through there, you will want to give it a name. Wait. Let it be something you do not understand for a moment.
Then we will have seen it together.
They lift the cover together as the room begins to brighten.
